useEditorFont.title: Use editor font
useEditorFont.description: Draw inline messages with the editor font and severity colours. Turning this off draws them muted, closer to the surrounding text; OpenIDEA renders annotations with the editor font either way.

maxDescriptionLength.title: Max description length
maxDescriptionLength.description: Longest inline message in characters, per diagnostic. Zero means no limit.

hoverMode.title: Hover mode
hoverMode.description: What a hover over an annotation shows. Plugin annotations cannot bind click intents in OpenIDEA, so the two click modes differ in the tooltip detail: the first shows the message with its tool, rule id and related locations, the second the message alone.
enum: Left click shows intentions, middle click jumps to highlight
Left click jumps to highlight, middle click shows intentions
hoverMode.default: Left click shows intentions, middle click jumps to highlight

showAgent.title: Agent
showAgent.description: Problems suggested by an AI agent. OpenIDEA reports none yet; the switch is kept for parity with PyCharm.

showDebuggerSuggestions.title: Debugger suggestions
showDebuggerSuggestions.description: Problems the debugger reports. OpenIDEA reports none yet; the switch is kept for parity with PyCharm.

example.text: Value of x is available at the breakpoint

showServerProblems.title: Server problems
showServerProblems.description: Problems the language server reports about itself, such as a crash or a failed request.

showOther.title: Other
showOther.description: Hints and problems no other severity covers.
